title: #50. Hadith Of Ka’ab Ibn Malik
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ ۝ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا السلام وعليكم ورحمة الله وبركاته

لَمْ أَتَخَلَّفْ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي غَزْوَةٍ غَزَاهَا إِلَّا فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ غَيْرَ أَنِّي كُنْتُ تَخَلَّفْتُ فِي غَزْوَةِ بَدْرٍ

وَلَمْ يُعَاتِبْ أَحَدًا تَخَلَّفَ عَنْهَا إِنَّمَا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُرِيدُ عِيرَ قُرَيْشٍ حَتَّى جَمَعَ اللَّهُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ عَدُوِّهِمْ عَلَى غَيْرِ مِيعَادٍ

وَلَقَدْ شَهِدْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْلَةَ الْعَقَبَةِ حِينَ تَوَاثَقْنَا عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنَّ لِي بِهَا

مَشْهَدَ بَدْرٍ وَإِنْ كَانَتْ بَدْرٌ أَذْكَرَ فِي النَّاسِ مِنْهَا كَانَ مِنْ خَبَرِي أَنِّي لَمْ أَكُنْ قَطُّ أَقْوَى وَلَا أَيْسَرَ حِينَ تَخَلَّفْتُ عَنْهُ فِي تِلْكَ الْغَزَاةِ

وَاللَّهِ مَا اجْتَمَعَتْ عِنْدِي قَبْلَهُ رَاحِلَتَانِ قَطُّ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُهُمَا فِي تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُرِيدُ غَزْوَةً إِلَّا وَرَّى بِغَيْرِهَا

حَتَّى كَانَتْ تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةُ غَزَاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي حَرٍّ شَدِيدٍ وَاسْتَقْبَلَ سَفَرًا بَعِيدًا وَمَفَازًا وَعَدُوًّا كَثِيرًا

فَجَلَّى لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ أَمْرَهُمْ لِيَتَأَهَّبُوا أُهْبَةَ غَزْوِهِمْ فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ بِوَجْهِهِ الَّذِي يُرِيدُ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَثِيرٌ، وَلَا يَجْمَعُهُمْ كِتَابٌ حَافِظٌ يُرِيدُ الدِّيوَانَ

فَمَا رَجُلٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَتَغَيَّبَ إِلَّا ظَنَّ أَنْ سَيَخْفَى مَا لَمْ يَنْزِلْ فِيهِ وَحْيُ مِنَّ اللَّهِ وَغَزَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ تِلْكَ الْغَزْوَةَ حِينَ طَابَتْ الثِّمَارُ وَالظِّلَالُ

وَتَجَهَّزَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مَعَهُ فَطَفِقْتُ أَغْدُو لِكَيْ أَتَجَهَّزَ مَعَهُمْ فَأَرْجِعُ وَلَمْ أَقْضِ شَيْئًا فَأَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَا قَادِرٌ عَلَيْهِ

فَأَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَا قَادِرٌ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَتَمَادَى بِي حَتَّى اشْتَدَّ بِالنَّاسِ الْجِدُّ فَأَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَالْمُسْلِمُونَ مَعَهُ وَلَمْ أَقْضِ مِنْ جَهَازِي شَيْئًا

وَلَمْ أَقْضِ مِنْ جَهَازِي شَيْئًا فَقُلْتُ أَتَجَهَّزُ بَعْدَهُ بِيَوْمٍ أَوْ يَوْمَيْنِ ثُمَّ أَلْحَقُهُمْ فَغَدَوْتُ بَعْدَ أَنْ فَصَلُوا لِأَتَجَهَّزَ فَرَجَعْتُ وَلَمْ أَقْضِ شَيْئًا

ثُمَّ غَدَوْتُ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ بِي حَتَّى أَسْرَعُوا وَتَفَارَطَ الْغَزْوُ وَهَمَمْتُ أَنْ أَرْتَحِلَ فَأُدْرِكَهُمْ وَلَيْتَنِي فَعَلْتُ

فَلَمْ يُقَدَّرْ لِي ذَلِكَ فَكُنْتُ إِذَا خَرَجْتُ فِي النَّاسِ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَطُفْتُ فِيهِمْ أَحْزَنَنِي أَنِّي لَا أَرَى إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَغْمُوصًا عَلَيْهِ النِّفَاقُ أَوْ رَجُلًا مِمَّنْ عَذَرَ اللَّهُ مِنْ الضُّعَفَاءِ

وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ حَتَّى بَلَغَ تَبُوكَ فَقَالَ وَهُوَ جَالِسٌ فِي الْقَوْمِ بِتَبُوكَ مَا فَعَلَ كَعْبٌ

فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَلِمَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَبَسَهُ بُرْدَاهُ وَنَظَرُهُ فِي عِطْفِهِ فَقَالَ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتَ

وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا خَيْرًا فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ كَعْبُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ تَوَجَّهَ قَافِلًا حَضَرَنِي هَمِّي

وَطَفِقْتُ أَتَذَكَّرُ الْكَذِبَ وَأَقُولُ بِمَاذَا أَخْرُجُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ غَدًا وَاسْتَعَنْتُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ بِكُلِّ ذِي رَأْيٍ مِنْ أَهْلِي فَلَمَّا قِيلَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ أَظَلَّ قَادِمًا

زَاحَ عَلَّيَّ الْبَاطِلُ وَعَرَفْتُ أَنِّي لَنْ أَخْرُجَ مِنْهُ أَبَدًا بِشَيْءٍ فِيهِ كَذِبٌ فَأَجْمَعْتُ صِدْقَهُ وَأَصْبَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَادِمًا

وَكَانَ إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ بَدَأَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَيَرْكَعُ فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ لِلنَّاسِ فَلَمَّا فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ جَاءَهُ الْمُخَلَّفُونَ فَطَفِقُوا يَعْتَذِرُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُ

وَكَانُوا بِضْعَةً وَثَمَانِينَ رَجُلًا فَقَبِلَ مِنْهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَلَانِيَتَهُمْ وَبَايَعَهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُمْ وَوَكَلَ سَرَائِرَهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ

اَلْاَخَذُ بِاالظَّاهِرْ فَجِئْتُهُ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ تَبَسَّمَ تَبَسُّمَ الْمُغْضَبِ ثُمَّ قَالَ تَعَالَى فَجِئْتُ أَمْشِي حَتَّى جَلَسْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ لِي مَا خَلَّفَكَ

أَلَمْ تَكُنْ قَدْ ابْتَعْتَ ظَهْرَكَ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لَوْ جَلَسْتُ عِنْدَ غَيْرِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا لَرَأَيْتُ أَنْ سَأَخْرُجُ مِنْ سَخَطِهِ بِعُذْرٍ وَلَقَدْ أُعْطِيتُ جَدَلًا

وَلَقَدْ أُعْطِيتُ جَدَلًا وَلَقَدْ أُعْطِيتُ جَدَلًا وَلَقَدْ أُعْطِيتُ جَدَلًا وَلَوْ أَرَادُوا الْخُرُوجَ لَأَعَدُّوا لَهُ عُدَّةً وَلَئِنْ حَدَّثْتُكَ حَدِيثَ صِدْقٍ تَجِدُ عَلَيَّ فِيهِ إِنِّي لَأَرْجُو فِيهِ عَفْوَ اللَّهِ

لَا وَاللَّهِ مَا كَانَ لِي مِنْ عُذْرٍ وَاللَّهِ مَا كُنْتُ قَطُّ أَقْوَى وَلَا أَيْسَرَ مِنِّي حِينَ تَخَلَّفْتُ عَنْكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَمَّا هَذَا فَقَدْ صَدَقَ فَقُمْ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ فِيكَ

فَقُمْتُ وَثَارَ رِجَالٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَلِمَةَ فَاتَّبَعُونِي فَقَالُوا لِي وَاللَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَاكَ كُنْتَ أَذْنَبْتَ ذَنْبًا قَبْلَ هَذَا وَلَقَدْ عَجَزْتَ أَنْ لَا تَكُونَ اعْتَذَرْتَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِمَا اعْتَذَرَ إِلَيْهِ الْمُتَخَلِّفُونَ

قَدْ كَانَ كَافِيَكَ ذَنْبَكَ اسْتِغْفَارُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَكَ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا زَالُوا يُؤَنِّبُونِي حَتَّى أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَرْجِعَ فَأُكَذِّبَ نَفْسِي

ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَهُمْ هَلْ لَقِيَ هَذَا مَعِي أَحَدٌ قَالُوا نَعَمْ رَجُلَانِ قَالَا مِثْلَ مَا قُلْتَ فَقِيلَ لَهُمَا مِثْلُ مَا قِيلَ لَكَ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هُمَا

قَالُوا مُرَارَةُ بْنُ الرَّبِيعِ الْعَمْرِيُّ وَهِلَالُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ الْوَاقِفِيُّ فَذَكَرُوا لِي رَجُلَيْنِ صَالِحَيْنِ قَدْ شَهِدَا بَدْرًا فِيهِمَا أُسْوَةٌ

خُلِقَ الْإِنْسَانُ ضَعِيفًا فَمَضَيْتُ حِينَ ذَكَرُوهُمَا لِي وَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَنْ كَلَامِنَا أَيُّهَا الثَّلَاثَةُ مِنْ بَيْنِ مَنْ تَخَلَّفَ عَنْهُ

فَاجْتَنَبَنَا النَّاسُ وَتَغَيَّرُوا لَنَا حَتَّى تَنَكَّرَتْ فِي نَفْسِي الْأَرْضُ فَمَا هِيَ الَّتِي أَعْرِفُ حَتَّى تَنَكَّرَتْ فِي نَفْسِي الْأَرْضُ

فَلَبِثْنَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ خَمْسِينَ لَيْلَةً فَأَمَّا صَاحِبَايَ فَاسْتَكَانَا وَقَعَدَا فِي بُيُوتِهِمَا يَبْكِيَانِ وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَكُنْتُ أَشَبَّ الْقَوْمِ وَأَجْلَدَهُمْ

فَكُنْتُ أَخْرُجُ فَأَشْهَدُ الصَّلَاةَ مَعَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَطُوفُ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُنِي أَحَدٌ وَآتِي رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَأُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ فِي مَجْلِسِهِ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ

فَأَقُولُ فِي نَفْسِي هَلْ حَرَّكَ شَفَتَيْهِ بِرَدِّ السَّلَامِ عَلَيَّ أَمْ لَا ثُمَّ أُصَلِّي قَرِيبًا مِنْهُ فَأُسَارِقُهُ النَّظَرَ فَإِذَا أَقْبَلْتُ عَلَى صَلَاتِي أَقْبَلَ إِلَيَّ وَإِذَا الْتَفَتُّ نَحْوَهُ أَعْرَضَ عَنِّي

حَتَّى إِذَا طَالَ عَلَيَّ ذَلِكَ مِنْ جَفْوَةِ النَّاسِ مَشَيْتُ حَتَّى تَسَوَّرْتُ جِدَارَ حَائِطِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمِّي وَأَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَيَّ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا رَدَّ عَلَيَّ السَّلَامَ

فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَا قَتَادَةَ أَنْشُدُكَ بِاللَّهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمُنِي أُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَسَكَتَ فَعُدْتُ لَهُ فَنَشَدْتُهُ فَسَكَتَ فَعُدْتُ لَهُ فَنَشَدْتُهُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ

فَفَاضَتْ عَيْنَايَ وَتَوَلَّيْتُ حَتَّى تَسَوَّرْتُ الْجِدَارَ قَالَ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَمْشِي بِسُوقِ الْمَدِينَةِ إِذَا نَبَطِيٌّ مِنْ أَنْبَاطِ أَهْلِ الشَّأْمِ مِمَّنْ قَدِمَ بِالطَّعَامِ يَبِيعُهُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ

يَقُولُ مَنْ يَدُلُّ عَلَى كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَطَفِقَ النَّاسُ يُشِيرُونَ لَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا جَاءَنِي دَفَعَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابًا مِنْ مَلِكِ غَسَّانَ

فَإِذَا فِيهِ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ صَاحِبَكَ قَدْ جَفَاكَ وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْكَ اللَّهُ بِدَارِ هَوَانٍ وَلَا مَضْيَعَةٍ فَالْحَقْ بِنَا نُوَاسِكَ

فَقُلْتُ لَمَّا قَرَأْتُهَا وَهَذَا أَيْضًا مِنْ الْبَلَاءِ فَتَيَمَّمْتُ بِهَا التَّنُّورَ فَسَجَرْتُهُ بِهَا حَتَّى إِذَا مَضَتْ أَرْبَعُونَ لَيْلَةً مِنْ الْخَمْسِينَ

إِذَا رَسُولُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْتِينِي فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَأْمُرُكَ أَنْ تَعْتَزِلَ امْرَأَتَكَ

فَقُلْتُ أُطَلِّقُهَا أَمْ مَاذَا أَفْعَلُ قَالَ لَا بَلْ اعْتَزِلْهَا وَلَا تَقْرَبْهَا وَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى صَاحِبَيَّ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَقُلْتُ لِامْرَأَتِي الْحَقِي بِأَهْلِكِ

فَتَكُونِي عِنْدَهُمْ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ فِي هَذَا الْأَمْرِ قَالَ كَعْبٌ فَجَاءَتْ امْرَأَةُ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هِلَالَ بْنَ أُمَيَّةَ شَيْخٌ ضَائِعٌ لَيْسَ لَهُ خَادِمٌ فَهَلْ تَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَخْدُمَهُ قَالَ لَا وَلَكِنْ لَا يَقْرَبْكِ

قَالَتْ إِنَّهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا بِهِ حَرَكَةٌ إِلَى شَيْءٍ وَاللَّهِ مَا زَالَ يَبْكِي مُنْذُ كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ مَا كَانَ إِلَى يَوْمِهِ هَذَا

فَقَالَ لِي بَعْضُ أَهْلِي لَوْ اسْتَأْذَنْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي امْرَأَتِكَ كَمَا أَذِنَ لِامْرَأَةِ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ أَنْ تَخْدُمَهُ

فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ لَا أَسْتَأْذِنُ فِيهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمَا يُدْرِينِي مَا يَقُولُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنْتُهُ فِيهَا وَأَنَا رَجُلٌ شَابٌّ

فَلَبِثْتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عَشْرَ لَيَالٍ حَتَّى كَمَلَتْ لَنَا خَمْسُونَ لَيْلَةً فَلَمَّا صَلَّيْتُ صَلَاةَ الْفَجْرِ صُبْحَ خَمْسِينَ لَيْلَةً

وَأَنَا عَلَى ظَهْرِ بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِنَا فَبَيْنَ أَنَا جَالِسٌ عَلَى الْحَالِ الَّتِي ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ قَدْ ضَاقَتْ عَلَيَّ نَفْسِي وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيَّ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ

سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ صَارِخٍ أَوْفَى عَلَى جَبَلِ سَلْعٍ بِأَعْلَى صَوْتِهِ يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَبْشِرْ قَالَ فَخَرَرْتُ سَاجِدًا وَعَرَفْتُ أَنْ قَدْ جَاءَ فَرَجٌ

وَآذَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِتَوْبَةِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْنَا فَذَهَبَ النَّاسُ يُبَشِّرُونَنَا وَذَهَبَ قِبَلَ صَاحِبَيَّ مُبَشِّرُونَ

وَرَكَضَ إِلَيَّ رَجُلٌ فَرَسًا وَسَعَى سَاعٍ مِنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأَوْفَى عَلَى الْجَبَلِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَنِي الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَهُ يُبَشِّرُنِي نَزَعْتُ لَهُ ثَوْبَيَّ فَكَسَوْتُهُ إِيَّاهُمَا بِبُشْرَاهُ وَاللَّهِ مَا أَمْلِكُ غَيْرَهُمَا يَوْمَئِذٍ

وَاسْتَعَرْتُ ثَوْبَيْنِ فَلَبِسْتُهُمَا وَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَيَتَلَقَّانِي النَّاسُ فَوْجًا فَوْجًا يُهَنُّونِي بِالتَّوْبَةِ يَقُولُونَ لِتَهْنِكَ تَوْبَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ

لِتَهْنِكَ تَوْبَةُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكَ قَالَ كَعْبٌ حَتَّى دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ جَالِسٌ حَوْلَهُ النَّاسُ

فَقَامَ إِلَيَّ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ يُهَرْوِلُ حَتَّى صَافَحَنِي وَهَنَّانِي وَاللَّهِ مَا قَامَ إِلَيَّ رَجُلٌ مِنْ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ غَيْرَهُ وَلَا أَنْسَاهَا لِطَلْحَةَ

قَالَ كَعْبٌ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَهُوَ يَبْرُقُ وَجْهُهُ مِنْ السُّرُورِ أَبْشِرْ بِخَيْرِ يَوْمٍ مَرَّ عَلَيْكَ مُنْذُ وَلَدَتْكَ أُمُّكَ

قَالَ قُلْتُ أَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ لَا بَلْ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سُرَّ اسْتَنَارَ وَجْهُهُ حَتَّى كَأَنَّهُ قِطْعَةُ قَمَرٍ وَكُنَّا نَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ

فَلَمَّا جَلَسْتُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ مِنْ تَوْبَتِي أَنْ أَنْخَلِعَ مِنْ مَالِي صَدَقَةً إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ

قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ بَعْضَ مَالِكَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ قُلْتُ فَإِنِّي أُمْسِكُ سَهْمِي الَّذِي بِخَيْبَرَ

فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّمَا نَجَّانِي بِالصِّدْقِ وَإِنَّ مِنْ تَوْبَتِي أَنْ لَا أُحَدِّثَ إِلَّا صِدْقًا مَا بَقِيتُ

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; لَقَدْ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنْصَارِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ فِي سَاعَةِ الْعُسْرَةِ الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ فِي سَاعَةِ الْعُسْرَةِ مِنْ بَعْدِ

مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا كَادَ يَزِيغُ قُلُوبُ فَرِيقٍ مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ إِنَّهُ بِهِمْ رَءُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ۝

وَعَلَى الثَّلَاثَةِ الَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا حَتَّىٰ إِذَا ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ وَضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَنْفُسُهُمْ

وَظَنُّوا أَنْ لَا مَلْجَأَ مِنَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيْهِمْ لِيَتُوبُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ۝

سَيَحْلِفُونَ بِاللَّهِ لَكُمْ إِذَا انْقَلَبْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لِتُعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمْ فَأَعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ رِجْسٌ وَمَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ۝

يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ لِتَرْضَوْا عَنْهُمْ فَإِنْ تَرْضَوْا عَنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَرْضَىٰ عَنِ الْقَوْمِ الْفَاسِقِينَ۝

جَوَازُ إخْبَارِ الرّجُلِ عَنْ تَفْرِيطِهِ جَوَازُ مَدْحِ الرّجُلِ نَفْسَهُ جَوَازُ مَدْحِ الْإِنْسَانِ نَفْسَهُ بِمَا فِيهِ مِنْ الْخَيْرِ إذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَى سَبِيلِ الْفَخْرِ وَالتّرَفّعِ

بَيْعَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ مَشَاهِدِ الصّحَابَةِ الْمُبَادَرَةُ إلَى انْتِهَازِ فُرْصَةِ الطّاعَةِ يَالَيْتَنِي فَعَلْتُ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ

وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ۝

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَجِيبُوا لِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ لِمَا يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَحُولُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهِ

وَنُقَلِّبُ أَفْئِدَتَهُمْ وَأَبْصَارَهُمْ كَمَا لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوا بِهِ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ۝

فَلَمَّا زَاغُوا أَزَاغَ اللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ ۚ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِي الْقَوْمَ الْفَاسِقِينَ۝

وَمَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُضِلَّ قَوْمًا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حَتَّىٰ يُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ مَا يَتَّقُونَ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ۝

لَمْ يَكُنْ يَتَخَلّفُ عَنْهُ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلّمَ إلّا مُنَافِقٌ أَوْ مَعْذُورٌ أَوْ مَنْ خَلّفَهُ النّبِيّ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلّمَ

جَوَازُ الطّعْنِ فِي الرّجُلِ بِمَا يَغْلِبُ عَلَى اجْتِهَادِ الطّاعِنِ حَمِيّةً أَوْ ذَبّا عَنْ اللّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ الْحُكْمُ بِالظّاهِرِ تَرْكُ رَدّ السّلَامِ عَلَى مَنْ أَحْدَثَ حَدَثًا

.تَوْفِيقُ اللّهِ لِكَعْبٍ وَصَاحِبَيْهِ جَوَازُ الْهَجْرِ لِلتّأْدِيبِ التّنَكّرُ وَالْوَحْشَةُ دَلِيلٌ عَلَى حَيَاةِ الْقَلْبِ دُخُولُ دَارِ الصّاحِبِ مِنْ غَيْرِ إذْن

كَانَ سُجُودُ الشّكْرِ مِنْ عَادَةِ الصّحَابَةِ.إتْلَافُ مَا يُخْشَى مِنْهُ الْمَضَرّةُ فِي الدّينِ.يَوْمُ تَوْبَةِ الْمُسْلِمِ خَيْرُ الْأَيّامِ

سُرُورُهُ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلّمَ بِتَوْبَةِ اللّهِ عَلَى الْمُخَلّفِينَ اسْتِحْبَابُ الصّدَقَةِ عِنْدَ التّوْبَةِ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرًا

اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمةُ الله وَبَرَكَاتُه’

The Life Of Muhammad ﷺ, Madinan Period Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, Dear brothers and sisters, We have one topic left from the topic of the Battle of Tabook(تبوك),

and this is the, what is known as the Hadith(حديث) of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).

This Hadith(حديث) has special significance because it represents a bad moment in the life of an exemplary man, special man, the companion of Rasool Allah ﷺ,

and it's loaded with lessons for us.

Because it is a story of someone, who struggled to do good, and then being a human being, he went through a moment of weakness but was able to get out of it because of his good deeds,

because of his Tarbiyyah(تربية), because of his Eeman(إيمان).

And I want you to contemplate on this Hadith(حديث), deeply and derive the lessons that are relevant to you, as a Mo'min(مؤمن), we'll go In Sha Allah(إن شاء الله) through some of these lessons, but I'm sure that I would miss many.

And therefore you need to have Tadabbur(تدبر), contemplation on these words of the great companion Ka'ab Ibn Malik رضي الله عنه.

I'm going to read the narration of Bukhari(بخاريْ) and this was narrated by the grandson of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) from his father, who was the guide of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), when he grew old and became blind

and the father is narrating his story to the son.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says; Ka'ab(كعب) says: I've never stayed behind any Battle of Rasool Allah ﷺ with the exception of the Battle of Tabook(تبوك).

But I also missed the Battle of Badr(بدر).

However, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not censor anybody who stayed behind.

And he gives the reason why, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not hold anybody accountable for missing Badr(بدر).?

Rasool Allah ﷺ went out in the Battle of Badr(بدر) with a different intention.

I mean, it wasn't intended as a Battle with the Mushrikeen(مشركين) of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ), but it was intended as an attack on the Tijarah(تجارة), on the caravan that was led by Abu Sufiyan(ابو سفيان),

they missed the caravan and then they ended up meeting the army of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ).

And then, they ended up meeting the enemy without an appointment, a prior appointment.

He says: However, I have attended with Rasool Allah ﷺ the night of Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه).

Remember, we have talked about Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه) towards the end of the series on Makkah.

And this is when the Ansaar(أنْصَار) gave Rasool Allah ﷺ the Pledge of Allegiance and they promised him support.

Ka'ab(كعب) says: I attended that, he was one of the Nuqaba'a(نقباء), he was one of the 12 leaders of Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار), who represented the Ansaar(أنْصَار) in giving the pledge to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Ka'ab(كعب) says, that I would not want to have attended Badr(بدر) instead of Al-Aqabah(ألعقبه), even though Badr(بدر) is more famous.

What Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is saying, that they consider the night of Al-Aqabah(العقبه) to be such an important and special event that he would not exchange it, with attending Badr(بدر).

But then he says, that Badr(بدر) is very famous and it has such a high reputation.

However, the Laila-Tul-Aqabah(ليلة العقبه) was also a very important event and he attended that, he was there.

And then he says; He said: And now he's starting to narrate the story of what happened on Tabook(تبوك).

He said: I was never before stronger or better off, then that time when I missed the Battle of Tabook(تبوك).

He said: Never before, did I own two riding camels.

But I did own them during the Battle of Tabook(تبوك).

So, Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) here is admitting that he has no excuse, he's strong, and he has a financial capability, which is represented in having a mount to ride, not only did he have one but he had two.

Rasool Allah ﷺ would never send out an army to fight a particular enemy.

But he would talk about a different destination.

Rasool Allah ﷺ does this to mislead the enemy, so he would never have, his destination exposed.

And he would do that in order to surprise the enemy and catch them, off guard.

That was the habit of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

However, with the Battle of Tabook(تبوك), it was different.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says; Because it was in a time of extreme heat, and it was a long journey and it was a numerous enemy, therefore, Rasool Allah ﷺ made the announcement public to the Muslims,

that we are going to such and such place, and we are facing the Romans.

And he did that so that they will take appropriate measures and preparations for this battle.

So, this shows you that Tabook(تبوك) was different and special.

The Muslims were numerous and the books of Seerah(سيرة) say that they were 30,000.

That is the most authentic narration that the number of Muslims was 30,000.

So, you can see that it surpasses any other battle before it.

I mean, in Fattah-e-Makkah(فتح مكه), they were 10, and in Hawazin(هوازن), they were 12,000.

And now suddenly, we have a jump to 30,000 even though it's just a few months after the Battle of Hawazin(هوازن), but Rasool Allah ﷺ made a full mobilization for the Battle of Tabook(تبوك),

and all of the tribes were called to, and summoned to attend, because again, of the special circumstances.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says: But there is no Deewan(ديوان).

Deewan(ديوان) is a register, meaning the names, there was no role, the names were not written.

And therefore he says; So, if a person wants to stay behind, he might assume that he would be undisclosed.

As long as there will be no revelation coming from Allah, exposing him.

Because of the huge numbers a person could assume that Rasool Allah ﷺ would not miss that person.

Because we're talking about 30,000 it's difficult to keep track of who's there and who's not.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says; And Rasool Allah ﷺ went out in that battle, in a time when the fruits were ripe, and the shade was alluring.

And this is a very important statement of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) here is being honest, in this narration, and he is speaking to us about the true reasons, and the hidden reasons

that are going within the mind and the heart.

He is saying that, at that time, it was a time when the shade was very alluring because it was very hot, and the fruit are ripening on the trees.

And these are temptations for a person to stay behind.

And then he says; He said: The Messenger of Allah and the Muslims started making their preparations.

And I began hurrying to prepare, but I would retire without accomplishing anything.

He had the intention to prepare, but he would not do anything.

Procrastination, a human habit, something that is usual, if you don't commit yourself, if you don't discipline yourself to do something, you're not going to do it.

And you're going to delay the work of today to tomorrow.

And that is what Ka'ab Ibn Malik رضي الله عنه was doing.

And then he tells us something, he said; I would tell myself that I'm able to do it.

Nafs(نفس), the self could drag you down.

If you don't discipline it.

If you leave your affairs to your whims, and just let it go with the flow, you're not going to get anything done.

And Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) was speaking to himself and saying I can do it.

Eventually he didn't do it.

So, we need to be very careful from the Nafs(نفس) because the Nafs(نفس) is lazy, the Nafs(نفس) is afraid, the Nafs(نفس) is weak, the Nafs(نفس) loves Duniyah(دنيا).

And if you don't force it, and discipline it and tame it to follow the orders of Allahعَزّوجَلّ, it will wonder with you and take you astray.

You have to be very careful. Your Nafs(نفس) could be your worst enemy, if you don't pay attention.

He said: ِ And time was passing by.

And people were deep in their preparation.

And then suddenly, the next morning Rasool Allah ﷺ, and the Muslims were ready.

That's it, they're set to go.

And I have done nothing to prepare myself.

He is at the initial stage, he has done nothing and the Muslims are ready to leave this morning.

I said: I'm gonna prepare, get ready within a day or two, and then I'm going to catch up with them.

They left and I decided to get myself ready and I didn't.

The next day, the same thing, I would come back and I would do nothing.

And that was the case, until the army has left and it was over.

And here brothers and sisters, if you think that you could hasten a thing, so you procrastinate.

And then you think that you can combine it and hasten it, many times what happens is, you end up doing nothing, because the issue piles up and piles up, until it becomes too much to manage.

And it ends up causing you, when you look at the amount of work that you have to do, you just end up giving up.

So, it's a trick from yourself to tell you to procastinate and then its another trick from yourself when yourself that's it, it's too late, and you end up, giving up.

Also brothers and sisters, this is another indication because here Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is talking about of the context of going out Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

Going out Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) is a caravan and this caravan is moving and it's going on continuously because Rasool Allah ﷺ says,

That this will continue until the day of judgment.

There will be an enemy that is fought at any point of time.

According to the Ahadith(احاديث) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, the Ahadith(احاديث) of At-Taefa Al-Mansoorah(طائفه المنصورة) Rasool Allah ﷺ says; They are fighting, until the end of time, until Dajjal(دجال) comes out.

And they will be fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله).

There was fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) yesterday, there is fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) today, and they will be fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(فِي سَبيل الله) tomorrow

and the caravan is moving, and the more you delay joining it, the further it will be and the more difficult it will be for you to catch up.

And this is exactly what happened with Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).

If Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) was not able and he failed to catch up.

Who do you think, you are to be able to catch up, if you wait for too long.?

And then he says; He said: And I was still thinking about setting out and catching up with them.

And I wish that I did.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) wishes that he did and one day, you will wish that you did, if not in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا) than in Aakhira(آخرة) when you see the great rewards that are given to these special people

whom Allahعَزّوجَلّ has bestowed his favor upon and guided them to the straight path and showed them the best of deeds, the peak and pinnacle of Islam.

You will desire that you did Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is saying; Laiytaani(لَيْتَنِي) I wish, I wish, that I did.

It was not destined for me to do so.

When the army left and he was left behind in Madina, he would go out, walk around, go to the marketplaces.

He said: Whenever I went out and mixed with people, after the departure of the Messenger of Allah, it grieved me that the only man I saw were persons suspected of hypocrisy,

or those excused by the Messenger of Allah because they were in poor health.

So, these are the ones, who stay behind the Munafiqeen(منافقين) and the ones, who are excused.

These are the ones who stay behind.

The Messenger of Allah made no mention of me, until after he reached Tabook(تبوك).

Rasool Allah remembered him, when he was at Tabook(تبوك).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: When he was in a gathering. What did Ka'ab(كعب) do?

A man from Banni Salamah(بني سلمه) said; This man from Bannu Salamah(بنو سلمه), the same clan of Ka'ab(كعب) from Al-Khazraj(الخزرج), he said: O Messenger of Allah, he was detained by his two cloaks

and looking at the beauty of his clothes.

Now, brothers and sisters, this is such a degrading statement that was made.

I mean, here you're talking about men.

They are True men, and they know what is shameful and such a statement is such a degrading statement against Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) and to say that he was held behind because of his clothes and staring at them.

I mean, he's like saying that, he is a woman, who just is enjoying her clothes and looking at how beautiful these clothes are.

It's not a manly thing to be concerned with how cute the clothes are and how handsome a man looks in the mirror when people are fighting, when people are in the battlefield.

So, it is a very shameful thing and Muadh Ibn Jabal(معاذ ابن جبل), who's also from Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار) and from the people of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), he responded to that statement and said;

What a bad thing you have said.

O Messenger of Allah. We know nothing about him but good.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was quiet.

Now, when Rasool Allah ﷺ is silent, that means that he is approving of what was mentioned otherwise, Rasool Allah ﷺ would answer back and let's take a look at this for a moment.

Who is Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك).?

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is a man, who was with Rasool Allah ﷺ from day one.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is a man, who is from among the Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار), who came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and invited him to Madina and they knew very well the consequences of such an act.

They knew that the Arabs are going to fight them.

They knew that they will sacrifice their selves, and their wealth for Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And he is one of the 12 men, who put their hands in the hand of Rasool Allah ﷺ and gave him the Pledge of Allegiance.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is a man, who was in the trench with Rasool Allah ﷺ in every day of battle, he was there in Uhud(احد), he was there in Al-Khandaq(ألخندق),

he was there in Fath-E-Makkah(فتح مكه), he was there Khaybar(خيبر), he was there Hudaybiyyah(حديبيه), he was there in every single important moment in the history of Islam,

and he just missed out on that single day.

Nevertheless, this man from Bannu Salamah(بنوسلمه) made that statement against him that he's staring at his clothes.

So, brothers and sisters, the action of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) made him a target, to these words.

I mean, he has put himself in a vulnerable position because of his actions.

He did something that brought and drew these statements against him, even though he's such a good and great companion of Rasool Allah ﷺ but because what he did was wrong, he got himself into that situation.

Regardless of whether the statement of this man is right or wrong.

He, Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is the one, who put himself in this situation to start with and Muadh Ibn Jabal(معاذ ابن جبل) spoke in defense of Ka'ab Ibn Malik رضي الله عنه

and Rasool Allah ﷺ was silent because Rasool Ullah صلوات الله وسلام عليه is taking by what is apparent.

And what is apparent is that Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) did not show up.

And then Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) says; And then when I heard the news that Rasool Allah ﷺ is on his way back.

I became very anxious.

And then I was thinking about lying and trying to fabricate an excuse to get out of the anger of Rasool Allah ﷺ, when I meet him.

And then he said, and I was seeking counsel, from all of those from my family, whom have an opinion that, I trust.

And then when I told that Rasool Allah ﷺ is almost here, all of the falsehood and those thoughts left my mind.

And I knew that I'm not going to get out of this trouble at all, if I lie.

And I decided that I'm going to speak the truth.

And here you can see Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), this righteous and great companion, falling into deep trouble and committing a serious mistake,

but because of his Eeman(إيمان), and because of the Tarbiyyah(تربيعة) that his Eeman(إيمان) gave him, he was able to pull himself out of this hole that he made for himself through his good deeds.

The decision that Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) made to speak the truth and not to lie, as we will see is what saved him, from this big problem that he got himself into.

I mean, you will see how serious staying behind is.?

Rasool Allah ﷺ arrived in the morning and when he would arrive from traveling he would first go to the Masjid(مسجد) and pray two Rak'ah(ركعة)

and then Rasool Allah ﷺ sat down for the people because the people would come and meet Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So he would sit in the Masjid(مسجد) and they would come and meet him in the Masjid(مسجد).

That was the congregation place for the people, the Masjid(مسجد).

And when he did that, the ones who stayed behind came to Rasool Allah ﷺ giving their excuses and swearing, making an oath in the name of Allah that we're speaking the truth.

And they were above 80 men.

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ accepted their excuses, and took what is apparent, took their words at face value.

And he took their pledge of allegiance, their Bay'ayah(بيعه).

And he asked Allah to forgive them and he left the insides of their hearts to Allah.

And this is a general rule that Rasool Allah ﷺ applied that he would go by what is the apparent.

And this is a very important rule that has a lot of implications.

We judge people according to what we see, if we see Eeman(ايمان) outwardly, we judge that they are believers, even if they are disbelievers in their heart,

if what we see from them, or acts of disbelief, Kuffr(كفر), then we judge them according to that even, if they are believers in their heart.

That is the rule.

And then we leave what is inside the hearts to Allah on the Day of Judgment.

But the rules that apply in Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), apply to what is apparent and not what is hidden.

And this is both for Islam(اسلام) and Kuffr(كفر).

So, I came to Rasool Allah ﷺ and I gave him Salaam(سلام), and he smiled to me but it was a smile, of one, who was angry.

And then he said: Come here, so I came walking to him.

And then I sat in front of him and he asked me and said: Why did you stay behind?

Rasool Allah ﷺ is asking Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), Why did you stay behind?

And we will be asked why did we stay behind?

Not by Rasool Allah ﷺ, but by Allahعَزّ وجَلّ on the Day of Judgment.

Rasool Allah ﷺ was there to ask Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), and that question still holds true today.

And it holds true in every time, when fighting Fee-Sabeel-Lillah(في سبيل الله) is a duty upon the Muslims.

Why did you stay behind, what is your answer?

Prepare an answer for Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

Prepare an answer for this question.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) has thought about this question deeply.

And he decided that he's going to speak the truth.

And then Rasool Allah ﷺ told him.

Didn't you buy your mount?

So, this shows us that Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) was not completely ignoring his duty.

He actually tried to prepare and he went as far as buying a mount.

I mean, it's not like he was completely oblivious to the situation.

No, he was thinking about it, and as we have seen, that he was so concerned and he would make the Niyyah(نية) everyday that he is going to get ready but he didn't.

Rasool Allah ﷺ told him: Didn't to buy your mount?

He said: Balaa(بلى), Yes.

And then he said; He said: In the name of Allah, if I sat with someone else from the people of Duniyah(دُنِيَّا), I would have assumed that I will be able to get out of his anger with an excuse.

He said: And I have the eloquence and I have the ability to argue.

Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) was a poet, and he was one of the famous and important poets of Madina, who defended Islam and Rasool Allah ﷺ with their poetry.

I mean, the most famous poets of Madina were Hassan Bin Thabit(حسان بن ثابت), Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) and Abdullah Bin Rawaha(عبدالله بن رواحة).

So, he was one of the three top poets of Rasool Allah صلوات الله وسلام عليه.

So, he's saying; I have been gifted with the ability to debate and argue.

I mean, he's a man who could convince you, with his point of view.

In other words, he's saying; that I could, O Messenger of Allah, give excuses that will sound valid and convincing.

But I realized that speaking this to you, would eventually be exposed because you are the Messenger of Allah, my lie will not go that far and I will be exposed.

So, here, he's saying that I'm going to speak the truth.

Now, with this statement of Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك), when he says; I have been given the ability to argue or convince.

Nowadays, many arguments are made for excusing oneself, of fulfilling their duties towards Allah, and religion of Allahعَزّوجَلّ.

And the most convincing arguments come from people who have a background in knowledge, the people who are well versed with the evidences, so they have the ability to pull out some Ayaat(آيات) of Qur'an and to pull out some Ahadith(احاديث)

and to pull out some statements and then bring them together in a way, that may sound convincing as presenting an argument that gives them an excuse.

For example, you would have people say that we are in Makkah and you would have others say that we are in the weak stage.

So, we need to apply the rules that apply to the weak stage.

Now, the thing here is, yes, there was a situation once upon a time 1400 years ago, when Rasool Allah ﷺ was in Makkah, that they applied rules of weakness before they went to Madina.

So, a person may come today and say that we are in Makkah.

So, you go to that brother and tell him; Well fine, if you are in Makkah, then why don't you go to Madina, Rasool Allah ﷺ when he was in Makkah, he struggled to go to Madina.

So, if you are now in Makkah stage, why don't you struggle to go to the Madina stage.

The thing is that, he wouldn't want to.

Why?

Because the pay in Madina is less than the pay in Makkah.

The life in Makkah is more comfortable than it is going to be in Madina.

And therefore this person is not willing to make the move.

The person would say that we are in the stage of weakness, well fine, if you're in the stage of weakness, then prepare yourself to get out of it.

But the thing is, you would find that person unwilling to prepare to get out of it, because he knows very well that the path to strength is a path that is paved with difficulty and sacrifice.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, Yes at one point of time, he was in Makkah and the Muslims were in Makkah, but they did all, what was humanly capable for them to do in order to get out of that situation.

If you look at the Seerah(سيرة) of Rasool Allah ﷺ you see that it is fascinating.

How Rasool Allah ﷺ would knock on every door possible to find a way out of Makkah.

I mean, Rasool Allah ﷺ would meet with the tribes, in every season of Hajj(حج), asking them to give him support, so that he can make Hijrah(هجرة) to them.

And when you do something once and twice and three times and everytime you get the same answer of rejection, you end up giving up.

Rasool Allah ﷺ, never gave up and he would do that year in and year out.

And he will do that with first tribe, second tribe, third tribe, fourth tribe, fifth tribe and never give up until, eventually he met with Al-Ansaar(أنْصَار),

and they are the ones who provided him with a base to spread the Daw'ah(دعوة) .

So, Rasool Allah ﷺ was trying every avenue possible to get out of Makkah and go to Madina.

He tried every avenue possible to get out of the stage of weakness into the stage of strength.

So, whoever today is saying that we are in Makkah, that person needs to get out of Makkah, and whoever is in a state of weakness needs to struggle to get out of that state of weakness.

Otherwise, the Ayah(آية) of Allahعَزّوجَلّ that applies, would apply to them.

Where Allahعَزّوجَلّ saysl; If they want to go out, they would have prepared to do so.

But without any preparation.

That means that the person is just paying lip service and it is not true.

So, Ka'ab Ibn Malik(كعب ابن مالك) is saying that I'm not going to use my argumentative abilities and debating abilities here.

He said; He said: And if I speak the truth to you, even though it might make you angry, but I am expecting that in the truth, will be the forgiveness of Allah.

I have no excuse.

He made it clear to Rasool Allah ﷺ that he has no excuse in staying behind.

I was never stronger and more able to go out when I stayed behind.

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: This man has spoken the truth, so leave until Allah judges in your situation.

He said: So I left and some men from my clan followed me and they told me; We never know that you have committed a sin before this, this is the first time.

Why didn't you give an excuse to Rasool Allah ﷺ just like everybody else did and it would have been sufficient for you, the Istaghfaar(إستغفار) of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Because the ones, who came before Rasool Allah ﷺ ask Allah to forgive them.

So, they told him: If you have came up with an excuse, Rasool Allah ﷺ would ask Allah for your forgiveness, and that would be sufficient enough to wipe out your sin.

And he said: And they were blaming me, until I thought about going back to Rasool Allah ﷺ, and making up an excuse.

But then I asked them.

Did anybody else say the same thing and get the same response.

They said: Yes, Two men.

They said: Like what you have said.

And they were told similar answer to what was told to you.

I said: Who are they?

They said: Mirarah(مرارة) and Hillal(هلال).

They mentioned to me two righteous men.

And I saw them as examples for me or these were two men.

So, therefore there's somebody else who did the same thing that I have did, and therefore he decided that he's not going to go back.

And this shows you that, we find when we will see company that gives us support.

So, when he saw that he has company in the action that he did, in telling the truth that encouraged him to carry on.

And this shows us the importance of having good company around you.

Because of the pressure of the society, see he was pressured to go back and make up a lie.

And he was almost going to do that.

So, the pressure of the society is very strong.

And therefore you need to surround yourself with like minded people, who will support you to do good, especially for those who are living in rotten environments,

in environments that are environments of disbelief and environments of Fitnah(فِتْنَه).

It's very important that you don't trust your abilities in survival, and you realize that you are weak human being.

A man has been created in a weak state, we are weak.

And therefore we need to have good company, it's very important to have likeminded people who would support you and advise you and Deenan Naseeha( دين النصيحه).

Rasool Allah ﷺ says, that Religion is advice.
